{{Quote|Some sort of cheese, isn't it?|Haydnat Treen|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
'''Duusha''' was a type of inexpensive [[Cheese/Legends|cheese]] made from [[Blue milk/Legends|blue milk]] and produced on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], among other remote [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. Aged in rounds, duusha took the same [[Color/Legends|color]] internally as blue milk, but the outer coloration depended on on the color of the [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] that grew on the outside of the cheese, protecting the cheese as it aged. As a result, duusha cheese could be various colors on the outside. Critics of [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] used the word 'Duusha' as a nickname for Fel. As Fel was raised among the blue-skinned [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], critics used 'Duusha' to symbolize that Fel was, to them, blue on the inside and a different color on the outside.
